lane_title: GitHub CLI Environment / Compatibility / Security Audit
purpose: CP4 adversarial compatibility oracle for the future GitHub adapter. Defines hostile inputs for every gh capability argument, observed gh 2.97.0 behavior on this host, and the guard each input requires. Any vector left unguarded by the CP4 adapter is a candidate Integration FAIL.
observation_note: local_2_97_observation records what the local gh 2.97.0 actually did on this host (read-only commands only; host is unauthenticated). exit 4 = auth required gate. Observations marked 'documented' come from local gh --help / gh help exit-codes / gh help environment, not live execution.

vectors.input_channel: owner segment of OWNER/REPO (repo view positional, issue/pr -R)
vectors.local_2_97_observation: gh repo view ../evil -> exit 4 (auth gate preempts owner validation when unauthenticated); no local path traversal occurs inside gh
vectors.risk_if_guard_missing: path-like owner flows into adapter file paths, log filenames, or spawn argv; ../ escapes broker scope
vectors.required_guard: owner must match ^[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9-]{0,38})$ before any use; value passed as single argv

vectors.local_2_97_observation: not executed with auth; unauthenticated any owner -> exit 4 before resolution
vectors.risk_if_guard_missing: bare .. accepted downstream and used in path joins or API calls
vectors.required_guard: reject non-matching owner; never path-join owner/repo with filesystem paths

vectors.local_2_97_observation: gh repo view -evil -> exit 1 'unknown shorthand flag: e in -evil' (cobra treats leading dash as flag cluster)
vectors.risk_if_guard_missing: leading-dash owner becomes flag injection; behavior depends on surrounding argv
vectors.required_guard: reject owner starting with '-' or '--'; if ever positional, use '--' separator or -R flag form

vectors.local_2_97_observation: not executed (would parse as nested OWNER/REPO)
vectors.risk_if_guard_missing: extra separator smuggles a different repo or breaks [HOST/]OWNER/REPO framing
vectors.required_guard: single-owner validation rejects '/'; join exactly one validated owner + one validated repo

vectors.local_2_97_observation: gh repo view owner\repo -> exit 4 unauthenticated; gh treats backslash as plain character, not separator (Windows)
vectors.risk_if_guard_missing: backslash accepted into API path or passed to cmd.exe-style tooling that treats \ as separator
vectors.required_guard: reject '\' in owner; never hand the value to a Windows shell

vectors.local_2_97_observation: not executed; leading whitespace would 404/exit 1 after auth gate
vectors.risk_if_guard_missing: whitespace-padded owner bypasses exact-match allowlists in broker policy
vectors.required_guard: trim/reject before validation; compare post-normalization value

vectors.local_2_97_observation: not executed; trailing whitespace would 404/exit 1 after auth gate
vectors.risk_if_guard_missing: trailing space hides hostile values or breaks parsing
vectors.required_guard: reject trailing/leading whitespace; single canonical form

vectors.local_2_97_observation: not executed (Windows argv cannot carry NUL)
vectors.risk_if_guard_missing: NUL truncation in C-string consumers, IPC framing, or log injection
vectors.required_guard: reject U+0000 anywhere in every capability argument before crossing any language boundary

vectors.local_2_97_observation: not executed; CRLF would be preserved as literal characters in argv
vectors.risk_if_guard_missing: log-forging, terminal escape, or HTTP header smuggling if ever interpolated
vectors.required_guard: reject CR/LF in structured identifiers

vectors.local_2_97_observation: not executed; U+2215 division slash is a distinct char, gh does not treat it as separator
vectors.risk_if_guard_missing: unicode separator confuses downstream splitters that normalize unicode slashes
vectors.required_guard: owner regex matches ASCII letters/digits/hyphen only; reject confusables

vectors.local_2_97_observation: gh repo view ../evil -> exit 4 unauthenticated; gh itself performs no filesystem traversal
vectors.risk_if_guard_missing: repo used in adapter file paths or cache keys
vectors.required_guard: repo must match ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ (no '/', no '..', no leading '-'); never path-join

vectors.local_2_97_observation: positional '-evil' becomes flag cluster -> exit 1 unknown shorthand flag (observed with repo view)
vectors.risk_if_guard_missing: flag injection
vectors.required_guard: reject leading '-'; emit repo via -R/--repo or after '--'

vectors.local_2_97_observation: not executable on Windows (NUL in argv impossible)
vectors.risk_if_guard_missing: C-string truncation in Rust/Node boundary
vectors.required_guard: reject U+0000 in every argument before IPC

vectors.local_2_97_observation: not executed; cyrillic 'о' (U+043E) is visually identical to 'o' but resolves to a different repository
vectors.risk_if_guard_missing: homoglyph repo redirects reads to attacker repo while UI shows the trusted name
vectors.required_guard: reject non-ASCII in repo unless explicitly allowlisted by exact byte match

vectors.local_2_97_observation: gh issue view 0 -> exit 4 unauthenticated (no numeric validation observable pre-auth)
vectors.risk_if_guard_missing: API 404/400 or wrapper confusion when 0 truthy-checks fail
vectors.required_guard: parse as unsigned integer, require >= 1

vectors.local_2_97_observation: gh issue view -1 -> exit 1 'unknown shorthand flag: 1 in -1' (parsed as flag cluster)
vectors.risk_if_guard_missing: negative number becomes flag injection or wraps in unsigned parse
vectors.required_guard: reject '-' prefix; digits only

vectors.local_2_97_observation: gh issue view 1.5 -> exit 4 unauthenticated (float passed through until API layer)
vectors.risk_if_guard_missing: float yields API 404 and wasted network call; could round-trip to wrong id in some languages
vectors.required_guard: strict ^[1-9][0-9]{0,9}$ (u32-range) before argv construction

vectors.local_2_97_observation: gh issue view abc -> exit 4 unauthenticated; with auth gh treats non-numeric as URL/branch candidate and errors exit 1

vectors.local_2_97_observation: gh issue view 18446744073709551615 -> exit 4 unauthenticated (passed through; u64 max)
vectors.risk_if_guard_missing: wrap-around in 32-bit parsers (4294967295) reads the wrong issue
vectors.required_guard: enforce u32 max 4294967295; reject larger before spawn

vectors.local_2_97_observation: not executed; u64 overflow string
vectors.risk_if_guard_missing: integer overflow panic/DoS in adapter parse
vectors.required_guard: length cap (max 10 digits) and u32 bound before any integer parse

vectors.local_2_97_observation: gh pr view 0 -> exit 4 unauthenticated
vectors.risk_if_guard_missing: API 404 or wrong-object resolution
vectors.required_guard: unsigned >= 1

vectors.local_2_97_observation: leading '-' becomes flag cluster (same cobra behavior as issue view -1)
vectors.risk_if_guard_missing: flag injection
vectors.required_guard: reject '-' prefix

vectors.local_2_97_observation: gh pr view 1.5 -> exit 4 unauthenticated
vectors.risk_if_guard_missing: float confusion
vectors.required_guard: integer regex only

vectors.local_2_97_observation: documented: gh pr view accepts <number>|<url>|<branch>; a bare 'main' selects current-repo branch and can resolve to an unintended PR
vectors.risk_if_guard_missing: caller-supplied string resolves to branch semantics and returns the wrong PR silently
vectors.required_guard: adapter must accept digits-only number (or exact https URL) and never pass arbitrary strings as branch selector

vectors.local_2_97_observation: not executed; u64 overflow
vectors.risk_if_guard_missing: parse overflow
vectors.required_guard: u32 bound + digit cap

vectors.local_2_97_observation: documented: URL form is accepted by gh pr view
vectors.risk_if_guard_missing: URL host/path smuggling: attacker URL points at different host/repo than capability scope
vectors.required_guard: if URL form allowed, parse and require https://github.com/<OWNER>/<REPO>/pull/<N> matching the scoped repo, then re-emit as number

vectors.local_2_97_observation: documented: --search takes a single query value; a query that equals a flag only stays literal if passed as one argv element
vectors.risk_if_guard_missing: if query is tokenized, '--web' becomes the flag and opens a browser / changes mode

vectors.local_2_97_observation: documented: literal within --search value; tokenized it would request output fields

vectors.local_2_97_observation: documented: literal within --search value; tokenized it would run a jq program over output

vectors.local_2_97_observation: documented: leading '-' inside a single --search value is a valid search qualifier (negation) and does not become a flag
vectors.risk_if_guard_missing: if adapter re-tokenizes argv it may flip to '-l abel:bug' flag parse error or worse
vectors.required_guard: single argv passthrough; document that leading '-' is legitimate search syntax when passed via --search

vectors.local_2_97_observation: documented: must remain ONE argument; split into two argv would make 'bar' a stray positional

vectors.payload: JSON field drift across gh versions

vectors.risk_if_guard_missing: adapter expecting a field that newer/older gh omits; silent data loss or parse failure

vectors.local_2_97_observation: OBSERVED: exits 0 with stdout {"hosts":{}} and stderr 'not logged into any GitHub hosts' — exit code alone cannot prove auth success in JSON mode

vectors.required_guard: auth readiness must be derived from parsed hosts payload (non-empty active account), never from exit code alone

vectors.payload: large JSON response (e.g. issue body > 1 MiB)

vectors.risk_if_guard_missing: truncated JSON parsed as success; data silently incomplete
vectors.required_guard: read stdout to EOF before parse; verify JSON parses fully; enforce response size cap

vectors.local_2_97_observation: killed gh yields truncated stdout and non-zero/absent exit

vectors.local_2_97_observation: OBSERVED: exit 1, stderr 'You are not logged into any GitHub hosts. To log in, run: gh auth login' -> AUTH_NOT_READY

vectors.local_2_97_observation: first PATH match wins

adapter_security_oracle.purpose: Defines the FAIL conditions for the future CP4 GitHub adapter integration. Meeting any single condition means the adapter integration FAILS the checkpoint.

integration_fail_conditions.rationale: caller-controlled executable is arbitrary code execution regardless of arg policy

integration_fail_conditions.condition: bare PATH-based gh spawn (no pinned absolute path)
integration_fail_conditions.rationale: PATH hijack swaps the binary; pin D:\environment\github-cli\bin\gh.exe

integration_fail_conditions.condition: caller can append arbitrary flags to the gh argv

integration_fail_conditions.rationale: output-shape and side-effect control must stay adapter-owned

integration_fail_conditions.condition: GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN reach the gh child env
integration_fail_conditions.rationale: token leakage into child process environment

integration_fail_conditions.condition: normalized query split into multiple argv elements
integration_fail_conditions.rationale: multiword search queries must remain one argument; splitting corrupts search or creates flags

integration_fail_conditions.condition: invalid owner/repo accepted by the adapter
integration_fail_conditions.rationale: unvalidated owner/repo enables separator, flag, path and homoglyph abuse

integration_fail_conditions.condition: truncated JSON still treated as success
integration_fail_conditions.rationale: partial output parsed as complete data silently drops information

integration_fail_conditions.condition: any write GitHub command appears in CP4 (issue create/comment/close, pr merge/close, repo edit, api POST/PATCH/DELETE, release create, workflow run)
integration_fail_conditions.rationale: CP4 scope is read-only; any write surface is an immediate blocker

integration_fail_conditions.condition: gh auth token output or token values appear in logs/docs
integration_fail_conditions.rationale: secret exposure; auth token must never be read or recorded

integration_fail_conditions.condition: adapter spawns gh directly, bypassing the Broker
integration_fail_conditions.rationale: all capability execution must go through the Broker gate and audit path

integration_fail_conditions.condition: a generic execute-arbitrary-command IPC is opened
integration_fail_conditions.rationale: generic exec surface turns the adapter into a shell

adapter_security_oracle.verdict_policy: ANY single FAIL condition met => CP4 GitHub adapter integration = FAIL
